sources.label: hackmit-2026 repository structure
sources.excerpt: Declared structure of the context-graph repository itself, written by hand from the tree at import time. Not a synthetic prepared example of another system; the paths are real, but this manifest is a curated summary rather than an automated scan.

sources.label: Feature specs under docs/specs
sources.excerpt: Decisions and constraints below are lifted from the reviewed feature specs in docs/specs (foundation, ingestion, workbench, compiler, MCP, proposals). Where this repository is the subject, 'synthetic prepared example' refers only to the payments demo fixture, not to these claims.

components.title: Server
components.content: Server-side TypeScript under src/server: graph store, ingestion, compiler, proposals, MCP, and HTTP helpers. Browser code never imports it directly except through Next.js route handlers.

components.title: Graph store
components.content: PostgreSQL-backed store for projects, immutable sources, node identities, append-only node revisions, and immutable edges. Enforces validation, authority rules, project mutation locking, and typed errors. Lives in src/server/context.
components.summary: Versioned graph persistence and authority rules.

components.title: Task context compiler
components.content: Turns a task into a bounded, explainable context bundle: embedding similarity seeds, weighted typed-edge expansion, authority-aware ranking, cl100k_base budget packing, and selection reasons. Lives in src/server/context/compiler.
components.summary: Semantic + graph retrieval and token-budget packing.

components.title: Ingestion
components.content: Prepared-manifest importer (validated JSON to a new project in one transaction) and the GitHub pull request adapter. Lives in src/server/ingestion.

components.title: Agent proposals
components.content: Turns text (agent notes, PR digests) into proposed knowledge through one strict-JSON LLM call, writing inferred nodes and edges with agent provenance for human review. Lives in src/server/proposals.

components.title: MCP server
components.content: Stdio Model Context Protocol server exposing list_projects, compile_context, get_node, get_source, propose_context, and ingest_pull_request to coding agents. Lives in src/server/mcp and scripts/mcp-server.ts.

components.title: Workbench UI
components.content: Next.js App Router UI: graph and list views, node detail with evidence, edit/review/archive forms, revision comparison, review queue for agent proposals, and the task context panel. Lives in src/app and src/components/workbench.
components.summary: Operator UI for inspecting, reviewing, and compiling context.

files.title: store.ts
files.content: createGraphStore: transactions, project locking, node/edge creation, revision append, graph reads.

files.title: validation.ts
files.content: Zod parsers for store inputs and the actor/authority matrix (authorizeCreateNode, authorizeRevision, authorizeEdge).

files.title: compile.ts
files.content: compileContext orchestration: snapshot, embeddings with cache, retrieval, packing, bundle assembly.

files.title: retrieval.ts
files.content: Seed discovery, weighted BFS expansion with hub rule, eligibility floor, scoring and ranking, selection reasons.

files.title: pack.ts
files.content: Greedy rank-order packing with full/summary/title representations and whole-text token counting.

files.title: import.ts
files.content: importPreparedProject: one transaction creating project, sources, nodes, structural and explicit edges.

files.title: github-pr.ts
files.content: Fetches a pull request through the gh CLI, builds a bounded digest, and runs it through proposeContext with the PR URL as source.

files.title: propose.ts
files.content: proposeContext: prompt, strict parse, transactional write of inferred nodes/edges with agent source, drop reporting.

files.title: server.ts (MCP)
files.content: createContextGraphMcpServer: tool registration with Zod schemas and GraphError to tool-error mapping.

files.title: Workbench.tsx
files.content: Client state owner: graph snapshot, selection, views (graph/list/review/archived), forms, highlights, task panel wiring.

files.title: PendingReviewList.tsx
files.content: Review queue of agent-authored inferred nodes with Accept / Edit & accept / Reject actions.

claims.title: Node history is append-only; sources and edges are immutable
claims.content: No product table is ever updated or deleted through the application. Editing a node inserts a new full revision snapshot; correcting a relationship means archiving a node, not deleting an edge. Revisions cite an immutable source. This is what makes provenance and history trustworthy.
claims.summary: Never mutate history; append revisions instead.

claims.title: Agents can only create inferred knowledge
claims.content: An agent actor with agent evidence may create or update inferred nodes and edges only; it can never create, edit, or demote a canonical node. Promotion to canonical requires a human revision with manual evidence. Enforced in validation.ts, not in prompts.

claims.title: The token budget bounds the complete rendered context text
claims.content: compileContext counts the entire rendered Markdown (headers, items, reasons, citations, omissions, warnings) with cl100k_base and guarantees tokenCount <= tokenBudget on every path, including degraded and empty-fit cases. Snippets are never counted independently.
claims.summary: Count the whole text, not parts.

claims.title: Default to a local ONNX sentence-transformer for embeddings
claims.content: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=local runs Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 in-process via @xenova/transformers 2.17 (the newer @huggingface/transformers native binding does not load on macOS 12). An OpenAI adapter exists behind the same interface. The cache key includes the model id so switching providers never reuses vectors.
claims.summary: Local model by default; hosted optional.

claims.title: Relative imports are extensionless and migrations are embedded strings
claims.content: Turbopack cannot resolve .js-suffixed imports to .ts sources and rewrites new URL(..., import.meta.url) file reads as static assets, so src uses extensionless relative imports and SQL migrations live in src/server/db/migrations.ts as strings.

claims.title: Pending review is derived, not stored
claims.content: A node is pending review when its current revision is inferred and its actor kind is agent. No schema or route was added for the queue; accept and reject are ordinary human revisions through POST /nodes/:id/revisions.
claims.summary: Review queue is a filter over current revisions.

claims.title: Proposal LLM calls retry with backoff and walk a fallback model list
claims.content: Free-tier Gemini returned 503/429 on most single calls, so each model gets up to four attempts with 1/2/4 s backoff and PROPOSAL_MODEL accepts a comma-separated fallback list. Provenance records the model that actually answered.
claims.summary: Retries plus fallbacks; record the answering model.
